name: Innsbruck Hofburg Advent Concert
beschreibung: The Hofburg musicians in Innsbruck set the festive spirit of the Christmas season with heartfelt melodies. In the historic Knight’s Hall of the Hofburg, traditional Advent carols, Tyrolean folk songs, and classical pieces fill the air. A magical evening in elegant surroundings.
kurzbeschreibung: A reflective Advent concert in the historic Knight’s Hall of the Innsbruck Hofburg – setting the mood for Christmas.
